\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ} (sukkā)}{ਸੁੱਕਾ (sukkā)}]{\pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ} (sukkā) — dry}

\label{lesson:PA-C143-sukka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for narrow, then the Punjabi for wet.

\emph{Read it:} \textbf{\pa{ਮਨਨ} \pa{ਮੇਰਾ} \pa{ਦੋਸਤ} \pa{ਹੈ।} \pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ} \pa{ਬੋਲਦਾ} \pa{ਹੈ।}} without stopping
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ}} — \emph{sukkā} — \textquotedblleft{}dry\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sukkā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sukkā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{sukkā}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Punjabi for narrow, then the Punjabi for wet, then say \emph{sukkā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Dry\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[(dialogue)]{Animals and the body — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R143-first-pass-animals-and-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for bitter and sharp.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a neck, a chest, a back, a waist, an elbow
  \item a palm, a fingernail, a brain, a heel, an ankle
  \item a ship, a traveller, an office, a factory, a library
  \item a town square, a garden, a pencil, a class, a teacher
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A neck? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਰਦਨ}}, \emph{gardan}.) A chest? (\textbf{\pa{ਛਾਤੀ}}, \emph{chātī}.) A back? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿੱਠ}}, \emph{piṭṭh}.) A waist? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੱਕ}}, \emph{lakk}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੂਹਣੀ}}, \emph{kūhṇī}.) A palm? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਲੀ}}, \emph{talī}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਹੁੰ}}, \emph{nahũ}.) A brain? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਿਮਾਗ਼}}, \emph{dimāg}.) A heel? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਡੀ}}, \emph{aḍḍī}.) An ankle? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਿੱਟਾ}}, \emph{giṭṭā}.) A ship? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਹਾਜ਼}}, \emph{jahāz}.) A traveller? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁਸਾਫ਼ਰ}}, \emph{musāfar}.) An office? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਫ਼ਤਰ}}, \emph{daftar}.) A factory? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਰਖ਼ਾਨਾ}}, \emph{kārkhānā}.) A library? (\textbf{\pa{ਲਾਇਬ੍ਰੇਰੀ}}, \emph{lāibrerī}.) A town square? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੌਂਕ}}, \emph{cauṅk}.) A garden? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਗ਼}}, \emph{bāg}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੈਨਸਿਲ}}, \emph{painsil}.) A class? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਮਾਤ}}, \emph{jamāt}.) A teacher? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਧਿਆਪਕ}}, \emph{adhiāpak}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Town, school and work — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R143-second-pass-town-school-and-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a salary and a tailor.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a salary, a tailor, a carpenter, a blacksmith, a potter
  \item silent, valuable, deep, light, heavy
  \item cunning, wise, innocent, round, straight
  \item crooked, shiny, wide, narrow, wet
  \item dry, dirty, sour, bitter, sharp
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A salary? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਨਖ਼ਾਹ}}, \emph{tankhāh}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਰਜ਼ੀ}}, \emph{darzī}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਰਖਾਣ}}, \emph{tarkhāṇ}.) A blacksmith? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੁਹਾਰ}}, \emph{luhār}.) A potter? (\textbf{\pa{ਘੁਮਿਆਰ}}, \emph{ghumiār}.) Silent? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੁੱਪ}}, \emph{cupp}.) Valuable? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੀਮਤੀ}}, \emph{kīmtī}.) Deep? (\textbf{\pa{ਡੂੰਘਾ}}, \emph{ḍū̃ghā}.) Light? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੌਲਾ}}, \emph{haulā}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਰਾ}}, \emph{bhārā}.) Cunning? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਲਾਕ}}, \emph{calāk}.) Wise? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿਆਣਾ}}, \emph{siāṇā}.) Innocent? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੋਲਾ}}, \emph{bholā}.) Round? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੋਲ}}, \emph{gol}.) Straight? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿੱਧਾ}}, \emph{siddhā}.) Crooked? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਿੰਗਾ}}, \emph{vingā}.) Shiny? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਮਕੀਲਾ}}, \emph{camkīlā}.) Wide? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੌੜਾ}}, \emph{cauṛā}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੀੜਾ}}, \emph{bhīṛā}.) Wet? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਿੱਲਾ}}, \emph{gillā}.) Dry? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੁੱਕਾ}}, \emph{sukkā}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੰਦਾ}}, \emph{gandā}.) Sour? (\textbf{\pa{ਖੱਟਾ}}, \emph{khaṭṭā}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੌੜਾ}}, \emph{kauṛā}.) Sharp? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਿੱਖਾ}}, \emph{tikkhā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
